attempts.prompt: A hairstylist stands behind a seated client at a salon mirror during a consultation, gesturing toward the crown of the client's shoulder-length wavy hair while both look at the reflection. Soft, even salon lighting, a calm and friendly mood, and a clean neutral interior.
issues: Composition does not match the brief: the stylist stands beside/in front of the client (to the left, facing her) rather than behind the seated client, so the mirror reflection does not logically show her behind the client.

Mirror reflection is geometrically inconsistent: the stylist appears behind the client in the mirror while physically standing to the side, and the client's reflection is shown from the front at a different offset than her back view.

Neither the stylist nor client is actually looking at the shared reflection as briefed; the stylist looks down at the client's head directly, so the mirror-consultation interaction is not convincingly depicted.

Gesture toward the crown is weak: the stylist's hand touches the upper back/top of the hair rather than clearly indicating crown volume, so the consultation purpose (describing crown volume, layer placement, fringe length) is only loosely illustrated.
Client's shoulder-length wavy hair is shown, but no fringe/face-framing is visible in the back view, and the round-face context is not conveyed.
